Question: Is it permissible to take 90 from the first year student of engineering. 90 is some what a ruku position like in old days. All men bow their head after the king and wish him. plz help me out. Answer ID: 1778 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 605/609=D) It is prohibited to bow down at the time of meeting or respect anyone by bowing oneÂ’s head. The Islamic way taught by our Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is to greet with salaam and shake hands. The Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) categorically disallowed from bowing down. Hazrat Anas narrated that a person asked the Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam): Â“Can we bow down if we meet a Muslim brother?Â” The Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) replied: Â“NoÂ”. (Mishkaat: 401) This is an un-Islamic custom which should be avoided. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
